clean_apply.method: the generated patch reverse-applies cleanly to the current overlay on the pinned base, proving the overlay bytes are exactly the patch result

compressed_debug_contract.policy: reference and candidate verification must succeed, each compressed fixture must resolve exactly one real compile unit, every emitted debug payload must be nonempty, GABI input must carry SHF_COMPRESSED, GNU input must carry .zdebug_info, and no replaced legacy payload or SHT_REL table may remain

initial_failure_and_fix.gabi_without_zlib: explicitly rejected because the original build had LLVM_ENABLE_ZLIB=OFF
initial_failure_and_fix.gnu_initial_observation: the pre-fix zlib-enabled run exited successfully and llvm-dwarfdump printed No errors, but it resolved zero compile units, retained stale .zdebug payloads and emitted zero-sized canonical replacements
mechanism: ELF SectionRef::isCompressed recognizes SHF_COMPRESSED but not the legacy GNU section-name/header convention
DWARFContext neither decompressed .zdebug_* nor mapped it to the canonical .debug_* identity
BOLT recognized .zdebug_* as debug data but its rewriter owned only canonical .debug_* names, so stale legacy payloads and detached ARM SHT_REL tables survived
repair: Object Decompressor now validates the GNU ZLIB magic and big-endian 64-bit size and uses the ordinary zlib backend
DWARFContext decompresses and canonicalizes legacy section names
BinaryContext resolves canonical debug identities through either physical representation
BOLT removes a legacy payload and its ARM SHT_REL table only after a finalized canonical replacement exists
mixed standard and legacy representations for the same canonical section reject before output
the reproducible build requires zlib and builds the inspection tools used by the gate

scope_limits: this milestone qualifies GABI zlib and legacy GNU zlib on one linked Clang Cortex-M3 DWARF5 fixture in addition to the prior producer/version/split/DWP matrix; it does not qualify every compressor, corrupted stream shape or producer extension
legacy GNU input is canonicalized to standard output for sections rebuilt by BOLT; an unchanged .zdebug_str may remain when its immutable string payload is not rebuilt
zstd remains unsupported by this build and is recorded as such rather than silently treated as uncompressed data
the 68-profile matrix and real M4 run are preservation and installation evidence, not complete x86-backend feature parity
the full BOLT lit diagnostic remains at the documented 23 failures in the mixed-version test environment
the FastDyn run checks fixed completed work and exact RAM state, not a statistically powered speedup claim
patch-aware transformation semantics remain a later phase; this production gate uses the current explicit empty patch contract

source_changes.build_contract: LLVM_ENABLE_ZLIB=FORCE_ON is reproducible and the build target includes llvm-dwarfdump, llvm-objcopy, llvm-readelf and llvm-dwp
source_changes.canonical_identity: legacy and standard physical names resolve to one checked DWARF identity, with duplicate representations rejected
source_changes.decompression: the shared Object Decompressor parses and validates legacy GNU ZLIB headers
source_changes.publication: rewritten GNU sections publish canonical nonempty output and remove only stale replaced payloads and their ARM SHT_REL tables
source_changes.test_contract: the producer matrix now requires real CU resolution, nonzero payloads and compression-form evidence for GABI and GNU zlib cases
source_changes.upstream_regression: the ARM lit fixture covers valid rewrite, canonical publication, relocation cleanup, invalid magic and ambiguous duplicate representations
